svg.metadata: DEXPI Diagram: P-05 - Generated with pyDEXPI 2.1.0 - https://github.com/process-intelligence-research/pyDEXPI

g.text: Berth 2 arms on the platform, south to north: LA-5101 liquid, LA-5102 vapour, LA-5103 hybrid, LA-5104 liquid (S-01); drawn left to right L, L, H, V.
16 inch, ~4,000 m3/h per liquid arm; the hybrid runs as the third liquid arm or, in line-up (b), the second vapour path; the vapour arm LA-5102 is needed for every transfer (D-032).
ESD-2 trips ESD-1 at once (C&E I-503 into I-501); the ERS valves (two ball valves either side of the emergency release coupler) close 5 s later by I-507, not on ESD-1;
ERS valves de-energise-to-trip on 2oo2 solenoids, channels A / B (XA-5130A / B, either lost: ESD-1); couplers UY-5135..5138 release on ERS closed or timeout (D-034).
Thermal relief to D-5101: PSV-5171 / 5173 / 5174 per arm section 8.0 barg (below the carrier, D-039), PSV-5118 15.0 barg. Vapour arm first, last off (S-01).
D-5101 sits at the platform low point (drawn above the header). Its vent BOG-5002 has no valve: it is the drum's relief path and stays open.
XV-5123 / XV-5125: open-command permissives, each opens only with the other proven closed (ZSC-5123 / ZSC-5125, C&E I-504 / I-505), never trip an open valve; key interlock at the arm (vendor).
Arm purge (D-026): before loading the N2 goes into the carrier's manifold (S-01); after loading the arms drain to D-5101 and the purge N2 leaves by the drum vent BOG-5002 into the vapour return.
HV-5119 normally closed (pump vent/drain). BOG-5003, DR-5002 to DR-5007, LNG-5005 to LNG-5007, N-5001: see the line list. Arm vents, drains, vapour arm N2 test point: arm package; O2: AI-5126.
Air failure: PZT-8123A/B/C (P-08, C&E I-804) trip ESD-1 first; XV-5101 and the arm isolations hold on accumulators, closing at their set speed; ERS valves hydraulic (HPU).
O2 above 5 vol % (AI-5126): C&E I-514 closes XV-5122 / XV-5125 with XV-5101 proven closed (ZSC-5101), else ESD-1 (I-501); ZSO-5122 not open in a transfer: ESD-1.
ESD-1: HS-5100A/B/C, XS-5108, XA-5130A / B; ESD-2: HS-5107A/B/C. XS-5100 'no carrier' mode ends on an arm unstowed or link healthy (D-034).
LNG-5006: P-5101 returns D-5101 into the header downstream of XV-5101 in the next cooldown (D-036). PZT-5181 / 5184 1oo2 5.0 barg: C&E I-502.
